texts.ALAB: Our products are deployed in AI servers built around NVIDIA GPUs. Sales to our top customers, including hyperscalers who purchase systems incorporating NVIDIA accelerators, accounted for a majority of our revenue. We have secured design wins across multiple NVIDIA-based platforms.
texts.AMD: We compete with NVIDIA in the market for graphics processing units and AI accelerators. NVIDIA is our principal competitor in data center GPUs and has significantly greater resources.
texts.CRDO: Our active electrical cables connect NVIDIA GPU clusters within AI data centers. Revenue from customers deploying NVIDIA systems accounted for a significant portion of our revenue. A small number of customers accounted for 80% of our revenue.
texts.ADI: Our analog products appear in a broad range of systems. Certain data center products are designed alongside NVIDIA reference platforms.
